data.title: Golf Greens
data.about:
Welcome to the pinnacle of luxurious living at Golf Greens in Dubai’s prestigious Damac Hills. Prepare to be captivated by Damac Properties’ extraordinary residential Twin Tower masterpiece. The luxury 1- and 2-bedroom apartments and 2 & 3 bedroom townhouses are designed to redefine class and sophistication. Towers A and B are 20-story architectural masterpieces adorned with verdant plant life, creating a breathtaking, serene atmosphere. 

Enter a world of luxury where every inch has been meticulously crafted with a keen eye for detail. Each tower’s spacious residences come with elegance, showcasing thoughtfully designed floor plans and the finest craftsmanship throughout. Smart technology is seamlessly incorporated into each room, kitchen and bathroom, resulting in a luxurious lifestyle. The luxurious fixtures, fittings, and furnishings provide the esteemed residents with a sanctuary of comfort and indulgence.

Strategically situated in an outstanding location, Golf Greens provides unrivalled convenience with various exceptional amenities and services at your fingertips. Enjoy the immaculate courses of the renowned Trump International Golf Course, or browse the numerous offerings of Damac Mall. Enjoy the peaceful environment of Fishing Lake while fulfilling your shopping requirements at the nearby supermarket. Indulge your taste palettes at our world-class dining establishments or explore the community’s vibrant retail establishments. As a resident, you will have access to abundant integrated facilities, such as pools, cafes, lush gardens, and top-tier security services, ensuring a luxurious and safe living environment. Large parking spaces provide the uttermost convenience, completing Golf Greens’ unmatched collection of amenities. At Golf Greens, every moment is imbued with elegance and sophistication.

characteristics_module.title: Experience the Pinnacle of Luxurious Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Unlimited infinity pools
  • Greenery embelled highrise twin tower
  • Night time Indoor Golf Simulator
  • Excellent connectivity to all main highways
  • Meticulously designed 1 & 2 bedrooms of apartments and 2 & 3 bedroom townhouses
  • Located in the well-established Damac Hills neighbourhood
  • Access to Damac Hills’ trendy wave pool
  • Close to Trump International Golf Club
  • Close to upscale restaurants and supermarkets for your daily needs

location_tile.title: Stunning highlight of Dubai’s Damac Hills
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Golf Greens is the stunning highlight of Dubai’s Damac Hills. This exclusive residential development, featuring magnificent towers A and B, is certain to captivate. Immerse yourself in a prime location that connects you to the bustling roads of Hessa Street and Emirates Road, granting you quick and easy access to a vast array of well-known local monuments and attractions. As a resident of Golf Greens, you are constantly accompanied by convenience.

  • 08 Minutes – Dubai Sports City
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Autodrome
  • 22 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 25 minutes – Jumeirah Beach
  • 25 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
